def bspl_basis(tt,knots):
    # simple hat/linear-spline basis
    cols=[]
    for i in range(len(knots)):
        e=np.zeros_like(tt); 
        if i>0: 
            m=(tt>=knots[i-1])&(tt<=knots[i]); e[m]=(tt[m]-knots[i-1])/(knots[i]-knots[i-1])
        if i<len(knots)-1:
            m=(tt>=knots[i])&(tt<=knots[i+1]); e[m]=np.maximum(e[m],(knots[i+1]-tt[m])/(knots[i+1]-knots[i]))
        cols.append(e)
    return np.column_stack(cols)

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = 0.313208411451037
    p = params
    base = p[0] + p[1]*v + p[2]*v**2 + p[3]*v**3 + p[4]/v + p[5]*x/v
    h = (p[6] + p[7]*v)*np.cos(w*t) + (p[8] + p[9]*v)*np.sin(w*t)
    return base + h
